description.zh:
本地计算节点名称，获取本地计算节点配置信息。

默认获取集群的配置信息。
description.en:
The name of the on-premises compute node. You can call this operation to query the configurations of the on-premises compute node.

By default, the operation queries the configurations of a cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc get-hybrid-cluster-config --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --node testNode --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
